products.notes: Distributor copy of Focal spec. 6 selectable high/low-level inputs (low 1.2-4.9 V, high 4.8-20.6 V) + 2 RCA AUX + optical (24/192). 8 outputs, max 3.4 V into 10 kohm. 10-band EQ per channel (filter type not stated; some retailers say graphic). Delay 0-22 ms per channel in 0.1 ms steps. HP/LP/BP 16 Hz-20 kHz. S/N 90 dBA analog / 99 dBA optical, THD 0.02%. 4 presets; Windows PC application; remote optional. Internal sample rate not stated.
